EmailTemplate.subject: [Webinar] Are you prepared to navigate legislative impact on collections?
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Live Webinar Thursday, May 4th | 12 PM ET Did you know big changes are coming in how higher education institutions can collect unpaid debt? Join us on Thursday, May 4th at 12 PM ET for an informative webinar to review anticipated changes and ways to prepare.
Bryan Dickson at NACUBO will highlight recent legislation and panelists from Texas A&M University, University of Northern Colorado and University of Pittsburgh will discuss how they are embracing change to get ahead of the collections game.
During this session we will discuss: How anticipated changes will impact campuses, Current policies and practices that may need to change, Tools needed to continue protecting schools, And more!
